description: This file defines the 'Multiplexer' class which implements the 'ReporterV2' interface, managing multiple reporters for test reporting, handling various test lifecycle events, and wrapping reporter calls with error handling.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A class that multiplexes test reporting events to multiple reporter instances, ensuring each reporter receives the appropriate callbacks.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2' indicating the reporter version.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Invokes 'onConfigure' on all registered reporters with the provided configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Calls 'onBegin' on all reporters with the test suite.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Notifies all reporters that a test has begun.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Forwards standard output chunks to all reporters.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Forwards standard error chunks to all reporters.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies reporters that a test has been paused.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Notifies reporters that a test has ended.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Aggregates results from all reporters at the end of testing, updating the overall result status.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Reports an error to all reporters.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Notifies reporters of the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Notifies reporters of the end of a test step.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Determines if any reporter outputs to stdio.
